## Ilaria RVC

- [Installation and updates](https://docs.ilariarvc.shop/ilaria-rvc/install/installation.md): Download the supported NVIDIA build from Hugging Face. Extract the whole archive into a writable local folder and run RUN_ILARIA_RVC.bat there. The...

- [Files, source setup and maintenance](https://docs.ilariarvc.shop/ilaria-rvc/install/source-layout.md): An inference export can be used for conversion. For a resumable experiment, keep the saved G/D pair and optimizer and training state together with the...
- [Version history and release differences](https://docs.ilariarvc.shop/ilaria-rvc/install/version-history.md): The latest Windows release is 2.4.1. Check your installed version under Other → Update Ilaria RVC. Use All changes so far there to browse the...
- [Compatible GPUs](https://docs.ilariarvc.shop/ilaria-rvc/install/gpu-compatibility.md): The Windows ZIP is about 5.00 GB. Extract it to a new folder and run RUN_ILARIA_RVC.bat, or RUN_ILARIA_RVC_LOGS.bat for logs. ContentVec and RMVPE are...

- [Lightning AI Studio](https://docs.ilariarvc.shop/ilaria-rvc/cloud/lightning-ai.md): Run Ilaria RVC in a browser with a GPU supplied by the cloud platform. Choose a notebook below. Enable an NVIDIA accelerator before running the first cell.
